decisions.reason: Correct: the refill needs settings that the spec plan format never defined. I added the low-water mark, the refill size, queries per topic, the wander depth and count, and a gap for each source to the spec plan format with defaults, and the plan now names exactly those keys for fill and for the check command, refusing an unknown key.

The plan and the spec disagreed. The owner decided that a search engine is allowed, not that it is required, and the spec already treats the URLhaus list as built last and off if unfinished. I fixed the spec to say the same of the search adapter and made the plan say it is complete without it, so no direction changed and the plan stays optional there.
